g.text: Mass at the ends of the grid
Each point is a monitored quantity. A box stands for a block of more than 30, with its worst value
as a point. A name is that of the worst quantity of its block. Dashed lines: 1.01 for R-hat, 400
for the effective sample sizes, 0.05 for the mass at an end of the grid. Dotted line: 1.05. Orange
triangles: beyond the dashed line. Sampler checks skipped: R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS. Their
threshold marks describe the values; the run has fewer than 400 sampling draws. Grid: the largest
posterior mass that a site has in the outer 2% of the range at each end, and 90% intervals of the
standard deviation of g under the prior and the posterior. Divergent transitions: 0. Iterations at
the maximum tree depth: 0. Smallest E-BFMI: 0.9.
